title: Umwubatsi Uhamye w'Agakiza
intro: Uyu muntu w’umuntu wihangana cyane kandi ufite icyizere kidakuka, yamaze imyaka myinshi akora umurimo w’Imana, ahura n’isuzugurwa no kwangwa bidasubirwaho. Inkuru ye ni igihamya gikomeye cy’ukwizera mu gihe cy’abantu batemeraga Imana, bikarangira ari ikintu gikomeye cyahinduye isi.
clues: Namaze igihe kirekire cyane mu buzima bwanjye nhamagarira abantu banjye gusenga Allah.
Abantu banjye baransekeje kandi banshinja amakosa agaragara n'ubusazi.
Nategetswe kubaka ikintu cyasaga n'ikidasanzwe ku muryango wanjye udakora ku nyanja.
Bake gusa ni bo bizeye kandi bifatanya nanjye n'umuryango wanjye muri iyi nyubako idasanzwe.
Nari mfite bibiri bibiri bya buri kinyabuzima mu bwato, nk'uko Imana yabitegetse.
Umwuzure ukomeye wuzuye isi, ukiza gusa abo twari kumwe mu bwato bwanjye, mu gihe umuhungu wanjye ubwe yazize ubukana bwe.
arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٔـٰتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًۭا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًۭا
verse: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers. (71:25)
